records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Partners
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Partners* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: First project hit day 1 (2026-07-13), but no invites and no key milestone since, and Mia hasn't replied to three outreach emails (email:aac58adb, email:2c6408b9, email:89ec7a15). Silence plus no_invite on a Starter account with 8 days left suggests low but nonzero unaided odds.

draft.subject: One next step for Union Partners
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

You've got a real project up and running in Wrenfield, which is the main thing — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

The usual next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to look at how your project is set up and suggest who to add first.

Best,
Priya
